question: What does GraphQL resolvedBy say when an App resolves a review thread, read as the App and as a person; and does a thread keep its replies when its first comment is deleted, and what is its first comment then?
pass: By issue 282: the trial-author App, by an installation token minted and revoked at the Maintainer's terminal, opens a review thread on a canary pull request and resolves it, and reads isResolved and resolvedBy; the Maintainer's read follows. Then a second thread, the App's, gets a reply, and its first comment is deleted; the thread's comments are read before and after. Pass if both are read whole and say: (1) isResolved true, with resolvedBy as GitHub gives it, read as the App and as the Maintainer, whatever it is, null among them; and (2) whether the thread survives, how many comments it holds and which comes first. This trial records behaviour; it fails only if a read cannot say these things.
